artifact.status: ACTIVE for the v2 evaluation engine once the P3 acceptance conditions pass. 0.2.0 and 0.2.1 stay replayable and byte-identical.

v0_1_artifact.statement: Recorded at Phase B. The v0.1 file is not modified; replay under v0.1 remains possible.

artifact.interpretation: Every threshold, lexicon, region table, title list, rule table, lane rule, flag and capacity parameter is data in this file. evaluation/ interprets it. Rule tables are ordered; first match wins. Predicates: equality, {'in': [...]}, {'is_null': true}, and numeric {'lt'|'lte'|'gt'|'gte': value or '$param'}.
artifact.no_fourth_verdict: Relevance, newness, lanes, completeness, preference, compensation bands and experience fit are separate outputs, never eligibility verdicts.

v0_2_0_artifact.statement: Recorded at P1a. 0.2.0 is not modified and remains replayable.

v0_2_1_artifact.statement: Recorded at P3. The 0.2.1 file is not modified; replay under 0.2.1 remains possible.

changes_from_0_2_1: Work-mode parsing (P3 §8-§11): 'hybrid' is a work-arrangement signal only when its context describes a work arrangement, office attendance or workplace model (lexicon.hybrid_semantics). Technical uses (hybrid search, retrieval, BM25 + dense, ranking, cloud, architecture, model, embeddings ...) are not work-mode signals. A bare 'hybrid' in the JD body with no context is not classified.

Work-mode source precedence (P3 §8): structured work-mode field > location > title > JD body (lexicon.work_mode_sources). A genuine contradiction between sources -> geography UNKNOWN + WORK_MODE_CONFLICT (GEO-R25, review-routing); a lower-precedence source never silently overrides a higher one.
Office-day wording (P3 §13): '2 days WFO', '2 office days per week', '5 days work from office', 'hybrid - 3 days', '2 days onsite' are parsed.
OI-049 (OR-62): a CTC-only range spanning the target carries CTC_BASIS_UNVERIFIED as well as COMPENSATION_REVIEW (COMP-C03).
CTC lane rule (OR-63): CTC_BASIS_UNVERIFIED is informational; it no longer routes to REVIEW by itself.
Base and CTC stated on one line with labels separated by | / ; , (P3 §20) are separate clauses, so base wins.
Direct fixed-term contracts (P3 §25): 'employed directly by', 'directly employed', 'fixed-term' are recognised.

Relationship signals (EOR, independent contractor, B2B, hourly contractor) are read from the structured employment field as well as the JD body (P3 §26); an independent-contractor employment statement is its own employment kind (FAIL).
A direct-company contract with no stated duration is UNKNOWN + CONTRACT_DURATION_UNSTATED (EMP-R14), not FAIL, pending OI-051.
Cross-source newness (OR-64): a higher-authority observation that changes the accepted material value is UPDATED.

parameters.fx_max_age_days_note: OI-040 (Addendum B): snapshot age is measured against the evaluation date; older than 14 days is unavailable (FX_STALE).

geography.note: Explicit residence/base/relocation requirement in a non-Bengaluru Indian city (OI-012).

A higher-precedence source states one work mode and a lower-precedence source makes a genuine work-arrangement statement of another (e.g. structured Remote + 'hybrid work model, 3 days in office'). Neither is chosen silently.

ruling: Phase B §8 (supersedes OR-15 Bengaluru onsite UNKNOWN; OI-013)

geography.note: Onsite with no identifiable city: every onsite outcome is FAIL.

compensation.note: Non-INR figure whose newest FX snapshot is older than fx_max_age_days relative to the evaluation date. Never FAIL.
CTC-only point figure at or above the floor and below target.
CTC-only point figure at or above target: CTC_BASIS_UNVERIFIED, never IN_TARGET.
Unchanged from 0.2.0. Whether CTC_BASIS_UNVERIFIED is also added is OI-049.
Range starting inside the target band and ending above it: labelled IN_TARGET by convention (OI-037); lane-neutral.
Safety catch-all: a compensation state the table does not cover resolves UNKNOWN, never PASS.

employment_type.note: Independent contractor / B2B / hourly contractor stated as the employment itself.
A direct-company contract whose duration is not stated is neither known short-term (< 6 months, FAIL) nor known long-term (UNKNOWN + LONG_TERM_DIRECT_CONTRACT). Held at UNKNOWN until OI-051 is ruled.

employment_relationship.note: Hiring company is the employer; no third-party relationship stated.

compensation.labelled_clause_split_note: P3 §20: 'Base: ₹25 LPA | CTC: ₹31 LPA' is two clauses (split only before a basis label), so the base figure is selected and CTC stays as evidence.

preferred: \b(?P<lang>{langs})(?: language)?(?: skills)?(?: is| are)? (?:a plus|a bonus|preferred|nice[- ]to[- ]have|an advantage|desirable|beneficial)\b

work_mode_sources.note: Precedence of work-mode evidence (P3 §8). Rank 1 is highest. A lower-rank statement whose mode differs from the highest-rank stated mode is a genuine contradiction (GEO-R25), never a silent override.

hybrid_semantics.note: P3 §9-§11. For each 'hybrid' token: the first cue among the next window_words words decides (work -> WORK, technical -> TECHNICAL; a weak technical cue such as 'model' is WORK only when the words before it or the sentence show a work arrangement / office attendance). With no cue after it, the nearest cue before it decides; then an office-attendance cue in the sentence -> WORK. With no contextual evidence at all, a token in a structured field (work mode, location, a location line, or a title suffix such as '(Hybrid)') is WORK and a token in the JD body is UNCLASSIFIED (no work mode inferred).

relationship_fields.note: P3 §26: relationship signals are read from the structured employment field as well as the JD body.

relevance.rule: STRONG: >= strong_min_specific_terms distinct AI-specific terms spanning >= strong_min_clusters clusters. MODERATE: >= moderate_min_specific_terms distinct AI-specific terms. WEAK: otherwise. NOT_ASSESSED: no JD text. Supporting terms (Python, Docker, CI/CD, RCA ...) are reported as spans but never count. Traditional-QA terms are reported and never count.

title_tiers.TIER_3: Title in neither list, JD relevance STRONG or MODERATE.

source_authority.statement: Factual authority: ATS/company site > job board. Freshness (first_seen) is recorded per source independently. Conflicting factual evidence across sources is preserved and sets SOURCE_CONFLICT.

cross_source_update.applies_after_first_run_note: OI-050 (open): when the board sighting and the contradicting ATS sighting are both in the run that first observed the requisition, newness stays NEW (pre-P3 behaviour, G111) until the owner rules. The lane is REVIEW either way (SOURCE_CONFLICT).
cross_source_update.note: OR-64: when an observation of strictly higher source authority (ATS/company site over a board) changes the accepted value of a material field, newness is UPDATED (the evaluation carries SOURCE_CONFLICT). When the accepted value does not change, SEEN_BEFORE and the conflict evidence is preserved. JD hash and raw listing strings are not compared across sources (their formatting differs by source).

rules.note: 7+ years or Staff/Principal/Architect title when relevance is not STRONG.

queue.note: Within employer_preference, PREFERRED_* categories are equal in policy; their listed order is a deterministic tie-break only.
queue.group_note: OI-046 (Addendum B): requisitions flagged IDENTITY_UNCERTAIN and linked by a PROBABLE_DUPLICATE identity link are presented as ONE review item (group_id + member ids) consuming ONE daily cap slot. Presentation only: requisitions, observations, evidence and evaluations are never merged.
queue.carry_note: OR-65: the first overflow day counts as carry day 1. An item overflowing on D is eligible on D+1 and D+2 and is PARKED on D+3 (carry_days > review_carry_days). STRONG is exempt.

flags.ctc_lane_note: OR-63: CTC_BASIS_UNVERIFIED alone does not route to REVIEW. BELOW_TARGET, COMPENSATION_REVIEW and every other review-routing flag still do.

legacy.scraped_jobs: Rows present at migration 0101 are archived as legacy and never evaluated under v0.2 (OI-034).
